name: sol
description: Connect ChatGPT to the complete permission-filtered SOL Full and Nexo MCP catalog, including Home Assistant, memory, WhatsApp and authorized local tools.

interface.shortDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your private SOL assistant.
interface.longDescription: Use ChatGPT and Voice to query live Home Assistant state, perform authorized device actions, play verified YouTube videos on configured TVs, search SOL memory and use other tools installed in your private SOL instance.
defaultPrompt: Ask SOL what temperature it is in the kitchen.
